Really beautiful art style. Definitely worth a try!

First off, the graphics on this game are beautiful (and fast). The greek amphorae style is astoundingly pleasing to the eye and the overall gameplay is great. When I first downloaded it, I thouhgt it was only multiplayer, but after a while, I found out how to play singlplayer and I love it.

Even on a slow-ish computer, the game runs (almost) fine, and during laggy moments, you can always just turn the resoloution down. If servers are dead, then host and use bots - their just as good at killing you!
Besides the fact of complete emptyness and just playing with bot it's really a great game if more people played it'll be better, way better
